verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦਾ ਪੜਦਾਦਿਅਹੁ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰ ਨਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: piau dhaadhaa paRadhaadhiahu kul dheepak ajaraavar nataa|

en.bdb: Guru Arjan Dev is the lamp of the line of his father, grand father and great grand father.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਖਤੁ ਬਖਤੁ ਲੈ ਮਲਿਆ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਸਪਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: takhat bakhat lai maliaa sabadh surat vaapaar sapataa|

en.bdb: Having merged his consciousness into Word he in a dignified way has undertaken the task (of Guruship) and being blest st one, has assumed the authority of the throne (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਥਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗ ਰਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurbaanee bha(n)ddaar bhar keeratan kathaa rahai ra(n)g rataa|

en.bdb: He is the storehouse of gurbdni (divine hymns) and remains absorbed in the eulogization (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸ ਮਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhun anahadh nijhar jharai pooran prem amio ras mataa|

en.bdb: He allows the fountain of unstruck melody flow unabated and remains immersed in the nectar of perfect love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜ ਸਹਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat hai gur sabhaa ratan padhaarath vanaj sahataa|

en.bdb: When the court of Guru assumes the form of holy congregation, the exchange of jewels and gems of wisdom takes place

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach neesaan dheebaan sach sach taan sach maan mahataa|

en.bdb: The true court of Guru Arjan Dev is the true mark (of grandeur) and he has attained the true honour and greatness
The kingdom of knowledgeable (Guru Arjan Dev) is immutable.
